description: This file defines a custom constraint validator 'LocalDateValidator' used in validation annotations to verify if a date string conforms to a specified format, locale, and rules. It uses Java's date-time API to parse and validate date strings dynamically based on fields annotated in the target object.

classes.name: LocalDateValidator
classes.description: A constraint validator for validating that a date string matches a specified format and locale, used as part of a validation annotation in Java bean validation framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the validator with annotation parameters specifying the field names for date, format, and locale.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks whether the provided object contains valid date information according to the specified format and locale.

methods.name: toLocalDate
methods.description: Parses the date string using the specified pattern, locale, and resolver style to validate its conformity.
